permit.applies: The employer in The Bahamas applies to the Director of Immigration, on a letter of request, before the performer arrives; for entertainers at least thirty days before the start date.
permit.first: An engagement by a Bahamian business (its business licence and National Insurance number go with the application) and, for entertainers, a letter of authorization from The Bahamas Musicians and Entertainers Union or United Artists Bahamas Union.

fees.what: Short Term Work Permit processing fee, 1 to 30 days (non-refundable)
Work visa fee for an entertainer, comedian, musician or dancer (Scale 5), per year; for up to a month one fifty-second of it per week, for more than a month up to eleven months one twelfth per month
Work visa fee for a person engaged in a short-term film production approved by the Minister of Tourism and designated by the Board

permit.union: Entertainers must have a letter of authorization from The Bahamas Musician & Entertainers Union or United Artists Bahamas Union.
permit.processingNote: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs' page (last modified May 2016) says a complete application is granted or denied within 7 days; the Department of Immigration's current pages state no time, and the same 2016 page's BS$100 fee is below today's BS$200, so the time may be dated. Entertainers' applications must now be filed at least 30 days before the start date.

sources.title: Bahamas Immigration Department, Short Term Work Permit
sources.said: Any non-Bahamian who desires to work in The Bahamas for a period ranging from 1 to 90 days must apply to the Department of Immigration for a Short Term Work Permit . The application should be submitted before the prospective employee arrives in The Bahamas. Short-term work permits are meant for emergencies only and should be a one-time application . … For a period of one (1) to thirty (30) days duration: $200.00 non-refundable processing fee … Letter of request addressed to the Director of Immigration … Copy of VALID business license , Certificate of Incumbency, or Certificate of Incorporation of Employer Copy of Employee/Employer’s NIB Card /Certificate … Entertainers must have a letter of authorization from The Bahamas Musician & Entertainers Union or United Artists Bahamas Union

sources.title: Bahamas Immigration Department, Public Notice: Short-term Work Permit Applications Submission (17 December 2025)
sources.said: Effective Wednesday, 31st December 2025 , all short-term work permit applications for entertainers must be submitted at least thirty (30) days prior to the intended start date.

sources.title: Bahamas Immigration Department, Immigration Fee Scale
sources.said: for a period not exceeding one month one fifty-second of such fees per week or part thereof for a period exceeding one month but not exceeding eleven months one-twelfth of such fees per month or part thereof. For a work visa for a person employed by any religious or educational or charitable organization or engaged in a short term film production approved by the Minister of Tourism such organization or film production being designated by the Board in writing for the purpose of this paragraph, in respect of an occupation so designated Nil … SCALE 5. FEES: $6,000 … Dancer Disc Jockey Draughtsman … Entertainer/Comedian … Musician

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, The Bahamas, Applying for Short Term Work Permit (modified 24 May 2016)
sources.said: Once the actual application has been accurately and completely submitted, the permits are either granted or denied within a 7 days.
